payload._note: Select Medical operates 107 critical illness recovery hospitals (LTCHs) in 28 states, 33 rehabilitation hospitals (IRFs) in 13 states, 1,933 outpatient rehabilitation clinics in 39 states and DC, 544 Concentra occupational health centers in 41 states, and 150 onsite clinics. The 10-K provides state-level facility counts in Item 2 (Properties) but does NOT disclose individual facility names, addresses, cities, or Medicare CCNs for the vast majority of facilities. Only two facilities are specifically named in the legal proceedings section: Select Specialty Hospital Oklahoma City (OK) and Select Specialty Hospital Wichita (KS). No CCNs are disclosed anywhere in this filing. To obtain the complete roster with CCNs, one would need to reference CMS Provider of Services files or other public data sources, as this 10-K does not contain that level of detail.
